Details zum Jobangebot
Let’s reinvent the future of better hearing together!
The Sivantos Group is one of the leading providers of hearing solutions worldwide, developing and distributing hearing aids under the brand names Siemens, Signia, Audio Service, Rexton, and A&M. We boast a history of more than 130 years of improving people’s lives by bringing cutting-edge innovation and customer care to those living with hearing loss. Our award-winning technologies and countless world’s-first innovations have improved quality of life for millions of users. Sivantos employs more than 5,000 people and sells hearing aids globally in more than 120 countries.
We are a team that strives for continuous improvement in customer value creation, and we are looking for the best talents to contribute to it. We are looking for a determined User Experience Designer (m/f) to join our office in Erlangen or Munich who wants to shape the future of hearing health care together with our cross-functional team here in Erlangen, Munich, Singapore, and Bangalore.
Our industry-first Signia TeleCare solution offers a whole new way for hearing aid dispensers to be closer to their customers every day. You will help us take this to the next level in our quest for a totally integrated dispenser solution. You will be the advocate of the user, bridging market and technology sides to deliver the next level of hearing health care, and you will lead the process from early user requirements and first concepts through implementation to final release.

Your new role

Analyze workflows of hearing care professionals and other stakeholders (perform customer interviews, focus groups, on-site visits)
Validate and prioritize new requirements to maximize business and user value
Design detailed and holistic application concepts with focus on user experience and customer needs
Iteratively test and validate your concepts with end users, adapt and improve where necessary
Document concept using personas, use cases, wireframes and interactive prototypes
Ensure high-quality implementation of the user interface concepts in close collaboration with R&D and product management in an agile development process
Continuously improve our design processes and methods
Coordinate projects with external suppliers (e.g. visual design, prototyping)
Your qualifications

Degree in User Interface Design, Usability Engineering, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field
More than three years of working experience as a User Experience Designer of complex software products
Demonstrable experience in all phases of a user-centered design process (research, requirements gathering, concept development, prototyping, evaluation, documentation)
Goal-oriented, results-driven, hands-on mentality
Proficient in using prototyping tools (e.g. Axure, Balsamiq, Photoshop)
Open-minded and curious, well-adjusted as a team player
Practical experience with agile software development techniques
Preferably experience in developing medical software products, audiology knowledge is a plus
Experience in working in interdisciplinary and intercultural teams
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Fluent in English (spoken and written), German language skills are a plus
Willingness to travel – also internationally
Among candidates with equal qualifications, preferential consideration will be given to those with disabilities.
Sivantos offers flexible working time including home office, an attractive salary package according to IG Metall collective agreement, continuous professional development, use of Siemens canteen and sports activities, numerous team and company events and much more.

The company, which develops hearing aid systems and associated accessories, faces significant competition from other major players like WS Audiology, Eargo, and Widex. These competitors are known for their innovative solutions and strong market presence. Since March 1, 2019, Sivantos Group has been part of WS Audiology, a company formed that day through the combination of Singapore-headquartered Sivantos and Lynge/Denmark-based Widex. Today, more than 10,000 people worldwide work with us in more than 40 countries, and we are active in more than 125 markets with a EUR 1.7 billion annual revenue. WS Audiology offers a diverse portfolio of technologically advanced hearing aid products and services across its brands, Signia, Widex, Rexton, Audio Service and others. One in every three hearing aids worn by people around the world has been manufactured by us. Our roots go back 140 years.
What unites our employees – even more than working on improving any and everything related to hearing aids, and advancing day by day – is the great joy in knowing that we are helping people live better lives. In this way, success is much more fun, and our jobs are much more fulfilling.
